statements.proposition: Removing the scroll_attempt_outside_content analytics event has no impact on user-facing features or app functionality.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: The only runtime code removed is one analytics logEvent call in wallet_main.dart; the surrounding early return is kept, so scroll behaviour is unchanged. Event classes and a category mapping are removed with no other behaviour edit. Compile success shown by Linux, Windows and Android build checks; some other CI checks failed (unit_tests, macOS, iOS, validate_code_guidelines) and their causes were not inspected. The analytics data itself stops being emitted, which is intended and not user-facing.
